maria: Quick heads-up — Pegasus (customer-site) on-prem deploy landed in scheduling. Target change window: 2026-03-23 02:00-04:00 UTC. Who's on call for smoke + rollback?
ajay: I can take smoke tests and be primary for post-cut checks.
sara: I’ll be on rollback standby and will coordinate with infra if we need ham-swap.
ben: I’ll own the DB migration step and be online for the 02:30 migration. Will post exact commands.
maria: thanks. ben — can you paste the migration command and estimated downtime?
ben: migration is incremental; expected lock ~1–2 min. Command:```./scripts/db_migrate.sh --env=pegasus-customer --batch-size=500``` I'll watch locks via `pg_activity`.
maria: perfect. ajay — smoke checklist please (short bullets ok).
ajay: smoke checklist (short):
• API health /openapi/health -> 200
• Auth flow: login + token refresh (use test account svc-smoke)
• Latency check: 95th < 300ms for /generate with 512 tokens
• KV cache warmup: request prefix check + cache hit metric
• Inference sanity: sample prompt -> expected token prefix (sanity check)
I’ll run a script for the latency and inference sanity.
sara: rollback plan (short):
1) Abort post-migration if errors -> run rollback script: `./scripts/db_rollback.sh --to=pre-migration`
2) Switch traffic to warm standby (ops-runner will handle route)
3) Revert infra changes via terraform state restore if needed
I’ll monitor for schema drift and ready to execute.
kevin: ops-runner (I’ll be the one on routing) — ensure we have a warm standby VM group and that health checks are green. I’ll prepare the traffic cutover playbook and post runbook links in thread.
